1.t: It's a Fae, Fae, Fae, Fae World
1.o: Bo has been living on the run from her strange appetites and what havoc they wreak. After leaving someone she kills out in the open, she is contacted by a group called The Fae. She discovers who and what she is, and is told to join one of two tribes.

2.t: Where There's a Will, There's a Fae
2.o: Fresh from the realization that she is a member of the Fae, Bo is approached by a strange client, Will, a real life Will O' the Wisp. The storehouse of jewels he's collected over the centuries has been stolen... by a human! While this line of work is foreign to Bo, Will offers her an irresistible payment - information about where she might have come from. As Bo gets involved in the recovery of Will's gems, she finds the shocking truth about the thief... and the weird and deadly forces that seem to also be on the trail of the jewels.

3.o: Bo and Kenzi open a private investigation office. Their first job is to find a missing student at a local college. Kenzi goes undercover in the college, Bo joins campus security to uncover what happened. Bo and Dyson's relationship goes on the rocks and another species of Fae is revealed.

4.o: When a Fury with an unfaithful spouse tries to hire Bo to kill her husband's mistress, Bo instead takes the side of the unsuspecting human woman and puts her under protection.

5.o: Bo is hired by a Dark Fae named Mayer to find out how a human managed to win a bet with him. The reward for finding out is having an Oracle reveal something of Bo's past to her. Bo solves the mystery by finding out that a Fae that can jump between human corpses, called a Hsien, managed the deed. In the end, the answers Bo seeks are not given, but she does learn one thing. Her mother is alive, and coming for Bo.

6.o: While tagging after Lauren and Bo in the Fae world, Kenzi becomes deathly ill (and incredibly grossed-out) when she inadvertently eats some toxic human soup at the home of an Aswang.

7.o: A murder-suicide leads a human household to hiring Kenzi as a Shaman. Accidentally cleansing their house, a psychosis-inducing venomous Fae spider tags along when she returns home.

8.o: Bo's freelance work earns her a lead on someone who might know something about her mother... but the trail ends at Lou Ann, a death row inmate who claims not to know anything at all. Desperate to prove otherwise, and increasingly convinced Lou Ann is innocent, Bo uses all her Fae connections to try and bust her out of jail. When she has to admit defeat, Bo's goal switches to one of personal vengeance: to find Vex, the Fae that framed Lou Ann, and make him pay.

9.o: A fun-filled Fae "high holiday" turns potentially deadly when a Banshee wail predicts the death of someone in Trick's bar to occur within the next 12 hours. After a scramble that puts Bo and Dyson on the Banshee's trail, the two learn the name of the Light Fae (Sean) who's marked for death – and his last wish is for them to help him reconcile with his Dark Fae brother. Bo has to heal the rift between the two brothers at great risk to herself, while trying to unravel and prevent the mysterious death omen hanging over Sean.

10.o: While investigating a baffling sex-related murder case, Bo comes into contact with Saskia, a carefree Succubus who has much to teach her. But as they work together to find the serial killer Saskia reveals her true Dark Fae colours, which tests the limits of this newfound friendship -- and of Bo's own inner bad girl. Now feeling like a third wheel, Kenzi joins forces with Trick in a race against time to help him keep an old promise and save The Dal Riata.

11.o: When Dyson wakes up bloody and without the last eight hours of memory, he finds himself accused of murdering Ba'al, a close associate of The Morrigan's pet psychopath, Vex, and takes refuge in Trick's bar, invoking sanctuary.

12.o:
Bo and Dyson go undercover as a married power couple at a swank country club to help an old friend from Kenzi's criminal past. At first they enjoy their taste of the good life – and the chance to play house. But soon the emotional pressure of the charade, and the increasing body count, push Dyson and Bo to a new level in their relationship... and prompts Dyson to give Trick an ultimatum.

It’s time for them to tell Bo all they know about her origins once and for all. But before Dyson has a chance to come clean to Bo, an unexpected arrival drops by and tries to silence him for good.

13.o: Bo finally learns the identity of her mother – and that those closest to her have been keeping secrets. No longer sure who to trust, Bo decides to track down “Mommy Dearest” alone, in order to extract the truth about her own origins once and for all. While everyone frantically searches for Bo, Dyson visits an ancient Norn, a wish-granting, tree-dwelling crone, where – in order to protect the woman he loves -- he makes a sacrifice that may change his relationship with Bo forever, as she prepares for a final face off with her deadly mother.

1.o: A nomadic Fae sideshow comes to town looking to take advantage of the chaos that the bombing of the Light Fae headquarters has wrought. Unbeknownst to the general Light Fae populace, The Ash is in a coma, and his bond with the land is weakening, which makes this the perfect time for the travelling circus freaks to steal the most precious thing the Light Fae possess.

2.t: I Fought the Fae (And the Fae Won)
2.o: The hunt for the new Ash is on. Literally. A traditional Stag Hunt is held, whereby the candidate who successfully tracks and kills the Stag becomes the next Ash. Bo barely takes a passing interest in this ceremony until a surprise visitor with a vested interest in the hunt appears in her front room.

3.o: As Bo struggles to accept the new terms of her and Dyson's relationship, she investigates an apartment building full of residents who appear to have lost their minds.Kenzi's choice to employ a Brownie to help around the house threatens to backfire on her.

4.o: In a move of sisterly solidarity, Kenzi drunkenly invokes the Russian hag Baba Yaga to curse Dyson for his behavior towards Bo. In the sober light of day, however, Kenzi and Bo seek to remove the curse.

5.o: Bo and Dyson team up to track down a stolen Mongolian Death Worm on behalf of Dyson's old wolf pack mate. When things get complicated, Dyson finds himself reliving his medieval days – tormented by the hard choices he once had to make, and fighting in the present not to repeat past mistakes.

6.t: It's Better to Burn Out Than Fae Away
6.o: The Morrigan enlists Bo's help to find a tortured graffiti artist under her employ. The young painter has killed a Dark Fae, and his urban murals are exposing Fae secrets all over town – with The Morrigan on the hook for his actions. In exchange for her help with the case, The Morrigan offers Bo information on breaking The Ash's hold on Lauren.

7.o:
Bo is happy for the distraction provided by an assembly of strippers that helps break an accused cop-killer out of the police station. While Bo goes undercover at a strip joint to follow the trail of one of the apparent accomplices, Dyson and Hale simultaneously track the murderer. Both investigations meet in the middle at The Hand of Glory – a disembodied hand with remarkable powers.

Coming off The Morrigan's shocking revelation about Lauren, Bo and the doctor have a difficult conversation.

8.o: Trick’s dear friend seeks his assistance when his ballet dancer husband goes missing – or rather, his ballet dancer husband’s corpse. Bo and Dyson track the dead ballet dancer to a bizarre figure, enlisting Lauren for her scientific expertise along the way.

9.o: A night out at the Dal goes awry when an insane trickster spikes the beer with a substance that transfers Bo out of her body – resulting in a ripple effect that finds our regulars inhabiting the skin of their friends, lovers and rivals. Suppressed – and not so suppressed – feelings bubble to the surface, and the brief stays in one another’s bodies gives each surprising insights into the other.

10.o: Bo joins the brutal world of underground fighting to help a human competitor juiced up on Fae "steroids" that are sending him on blackout rages – and putting his son in harm's way. Meanwhile, the sister of the first boy she ever killed shows up and confronts Bo over her deadly past.

11.o: When rich young humans start turning up dead, Bo agrees to go undercover to help Dyson find the Fae responsible. As she makes her way through the "Gossip Girl" world, Bo learns a deadly kind of class warfare is afoot.

12.o: Bo enlists Dyson’s help to find an artifact she believes will release Nadia from her coma -- even though it might mean having to say goodbye to Lauren.

13.o: When Trick takes matters into his own hands to foresee the future, he runs the risk of revealing too much to the wrong Fae. Meanwhile, a furious Bo confronts The Ash about a betrayal… and is stunned by his response.

14.o: While Bo continues to ponder The Ash’s shocking proposal, she agrees to his interim request – to kidnap a Genie. The assignment becomes complicated and dangerous, and Bo finds herself involved with the most unlikely partner.

15.o: What Bo uncovers while investigating the mysterious disappearance of human backpackers threatens her own fine physique. Meanwhile, the new man in Bo’s life sets events in motion that force Kenzi to make a desperate choice.

16.o: Bo goes undercover as a high school teacher to investigate a mysterious case and Kenzi soon regrets agreeing to help her. Lauren makes a much anticipated return home from vacation.

17.t: The Girl Who Fae'd With Fire
17.o: Things heat up when Bo tangles with Fae politics in an attempt to save some very important people. Meanwhile, Kenzi risks more than she intended when she does a favour for Hale.

18.o: Kenzi and Trick must race to save Bo from the fallout of a steamy night gone awry before it binds the Succubus for a millennium. In its wake, Bo poses very uncomfortable questions to Trick about her origins.

19.o: Bo confronts a very powerful Fae, uncertain whether she can trust The Ash’s counsel. The coming War takes its first casualties – literally and figuratively – which challenges Bo’s and Kenzi’s commitments to the cause and the ones they love.

20.o: The Ash takes drastic action against the threat bearing down on him, which in turn convinces Bo to make a potentially life-threatening decision. When those close to her suffer devastating injuries, Bo can no longer ignore her destiny.

21.o: In the wake of emotional losses, Trick reveals his deepest secret to Bo. Bo realizes there is no turning back and she must go to any extreme, which includes aligning herself with a sworn enemy, to take on a battle that could decide the fate of the Fae.

22.o: Concerned that Bo’s plan is too risky, Trick offers Bo one more weapon for her own, and everyone else’s, safety. Bo must lead her friends into battle ahead of schedule when her hand is forced by their enemy. A revelation from Dyson provides Bo with ammunition, but another’s deceit threatens the mission. Prophecies come true… but at what cost?

1.o: Bo risks her freedom to do a favor for Lauren, only to discover she’ll have to do it “au naturel.” The new Ash is revealed and Bo’s new appetites shock…has she not recovered from last season’s battle after all?

2.o: When Kenzi’s childhood friend is snatched away before her eyes, Bo follows her underground to help find him. Meanwhile, Dyson’s new partner looks like trouble for Bo.

3.o: Bo’s houseguest Vex unwittingly brings “greetings” from a vengeful Morrigan - sparking a chaotic role-reversal that demands humans as Kenzi and Lauren work together to save their Fae friends.

4.o: Bo and Dyson take on a case in the world of new age psychology, and Bo suffers the consequences of denying her ravenous hunger.

5.o: When humans start dissolving into goo, Bo uncovers a nefarious twist to a sexy Key Club. Meanwhile, Bo becomes concerned over Kenzi’s attachment to her forcing Bo to make an extreme revelation about her friend.

6.o: The gang is forced to stage an intervention against an increasingly erratic Bo. Forcing Bo to learn the truth about secrets kept by the people she trusted most.

7.o: Bo faces the daunting task of returning to where it all started: down home on the farm. There Bo faces her old demons - and a new one -to clear the way for the path she will soon be forced to travel.

8.o: What was meant as a much-needed night off for Bo grows into a scavenger hunt in a lawless Dark Fae territory. In Bo’s absence, Trick is placed in a precarious position with potentially dire consequences.

9.o: Reality and fantasy converge as Bo confronts her ultimate challenge. Trick dreads the meaning of something he sees.

10.o: Bo, Dyson and Kenzi go undercover at an urban camp to catch a serial killer Fae who preys on at risk youth. A blast from the past greets Tamsin, but the visit may not be purely social. Bo is given some emotional news that is hard for her to accept.

11.o: Bo and Kenzi become entangled in the schemes of a gated community when a babysitter pleads for their help to prove her employer has met with a foul end. Meanwhile, Lauren comes to a difficult – and dangerous – decision.

12.o: Chaos strikes during a daring attack on The Dal, leaving the fate of one of the gang in the balance. Meanwhile, The Morrigan leaps on the opportunity to ignite the tensions between Light and Dark… catching Kenzi and Hale in the crossfire.

13.o: Bo attempts an unlikely rescue against an army to save two people who are dear to her – unaware of the dangers facing those she leaves behind. Kenzi has an epiphany about Hale. Dyson is given an important clue to Bo’s past, just as doubt is cast on his own future.

1.o: The gang takes on a case of stolen memory, only to discover they're all forgetting something… or someone. The new Morrígan is hell-bent on making sure some memories stay buried forever.

2.o: Dyson seeks out an elemental Fae to rescue someone he loves. Kenzi’s stuck on babysitting duty – but her unlikely charge might be the key to cracking the case.

3.o: Dyson rushes to be by Bo's side when she puts her life on the line to save a haunted family. At the same time, Lauren finds, much to her dismay, that she can no longer outrun her past.

4.o: When the Clubhouse is robbed, Kenzi's forced to make a confession that could threaten her friendship with Bo. An angry and frustrated Bo confronts a dangerous foe and makes a shocking discovery.

5.o: Bo's pursuit for answers steers the group to a Dark Fae party, with a dangerous guest list. Trick is summoned to appear before the Una Mens.

6.o: Bo fights for the freedom of a talented opera singer, whose voice could be the key to unlocking the answers she seeks. Kenzi is threatened by someone from Hale's past.

7.o: Bo and Lauren team up to venture into Dyson’s memory when he's on trial for a murder.

8.o: Bo’s friends are having too much fun celebrating the Yule to realize that she's gone missing. But when the night starts repeating itself, Bo makes it her mission to stop it. Meanwhile, Lauren and Dyson disagree over a mysterious package addressed to Bo.

9.o: Bo resolves to go to hell and back to get the answers she’s been searching for, with or without her friends' support. Meanwhile, Kenzi's determined to uncover what Trick's hiding.

10.o: With the gang still reeling from Bo's shocking announcement, Kenzi signs them up for an undercover mission at a mysterious corporation. Meanwhile, Bo retraces the steps that may lead to her destiny.

11.o: After Bo narrowly escapes an attack by a vengeful Fae, the team tracks down who sent it, only to make Bo doubt her feelings for someone she loves. Meanwhile, Kenzi's surprised by a visit.

12.o: Bo is reluctant to comply with her role in a prophecy foretold by an order of Knights, until advice from a surprising source helps her make a difficult decision.

13.o: Bo is forced to make the toughest decision of her life to stop evil from bringing destruction on her world.

1.o: Bo goes to hell and back to rescue a friend while Tamsin faces a foe from her past.

2.o: Bo needs the help of an estranged family member. Lauren finds herself haunted by a mysterious spirit.

3.o: Bo and Tamsin protect a Japanese warrior with a hit on his head. Lauren deals with death threats of her own.

4.o: Bo and Tamsin disagree over a young Fae who asks for help. Trick turns to Dyson with a mysterious case and an unwanted partner.

5.o: When an oracle goes missing, Bo poses undercover on a Fae dating website to lure the suspect.

6.o: Bo and Tamsin infiltrate the world of college football to investigate a homicide that might expose the Fae. Dyson investigates a murder victim who won’t stay dead.

7.o: Bo and the gang deal with the aftermath of a storm.

8.o: Bo and the gang attend a party with a mission to take down a new enemy.

9.o: Bo and her allies race to stop an ancient evil from wreaking mass destruction.

10.o: Bo risks life and limb to retrieve an elusive Fae painting for a friend. Lauren makes a stunning revelation.

11.o: A dangerous mission forces Tamsin to confront past mistakes. Meanwhile, Lauren must deliver bad news to a friend.

12.o: Bo tracks down an old foe who has taken on a new form.

13.o: Bo searches for truth when conflicting versions of her past emerge.

14.o: Under lockdown, the gang rallies to save one of their own.

15.o: Bo is forced to make a difficult decision.

16.o: Bo and her allies face the ultimate threat.

1.o: Yuki, Kurumi, Rii-san and Mi-kun are the happy members of the School Life Club. Their goal is to be in touch with the many things that one couldn't be exposed to if they'd only been in class. And to that end, they sleep at school.

2.o: Another day, another exciting morning for the School Living club! It's summertime, and Yuki is ready to finish her last tutoring session with Megu and start enjoying summer break. She's ready for all the summer traditions, like the beach, fireworks, and of course, a test of courage! She's eager to get her fellow club members to brave the school at night, but you never know what could be lurking in the darkness...

3.o: The power's out and everyone's bummed about not being able to cook or shower...at least until Yuki cheerfully suggests camping out! The girls pitch tents in the classroom and stay up talking late into the night. Meanwhile, Megu thinks back to the day where it all began...where everyone's definition of a normal day changed forever.

4.o: Yuki is practically bouncing off the walls after coming up with an idea to take a field trip outside the school grounds. Rii-san and Kurumi remind her that club members aren't supposed to leave the grounds, but Yuki's convinced that if it's a school-sponsored activity they won't be breaking the rules. Their destination: the mall! Take a stroll down memory lane, to the days before the group first met Mii-kun.

5.o: Yuki and the gang begin their "field trip" to a mall on the outskirts of town. While raiding the supermarket on the basement for supplies, Kurumi chances upon a puppy... None other than the School Living Club's future mascot, Taromaru! He happily joins the girls as they make their way to the fifth floor, where Mii-kun remains hunkered down.

6.o: The School Living club has new members! After bringing Mii-kun and Taromaru back from the besieged fort in the shopping mall, Yuki and Megu-nee take them on a grand tour of the school. For a moment, Mii-kun feels like life might just have gone back to normal...especially when Yuki decides to welcome her to the club by holding a field day event!

7.o: Yuki sits in an after-school study session, working hard on classic lit (one of her worst subjects). Mii-kun stops by to help tutor her senpai, and as she recites from "An Account of My Hut" Yuki exclaims that old books are like letters from the past. Inspired, Yuki rounds up the School Living Club and the four girls sit down to pen a message to the world.

8.o: A swim in the rooftop "lake" leaves Taromaru covered in nasty green algae, leaving Yuki to give him a bath and the rest of the club to take care of her equally dirty laundry. As the four stand under the sun watching the clothes dry, the conversation turns to "graduation" and their plans for the future. Later that night, a bout of insomnia leads Mii-kun and Rii-san to search for the lock to Megu-nee's secret key.

9.o: What could possibly have possessed Yuki to make her charge into the club room brandishing a deck brush and shouting about cleaning up? The brilliant idea to turn the rooftop lake (a.k.a the water storage tank) into a pool for the day! The girls carefully transfer the lake's fish to buckets, scrub out the algae and pond scum, and let their troubles slip away for the day as they enjoy their new pool.

10.o: It's pouring rain. The School Living club girls are gathered in the club room, but things take a worrying turn when Taromaru doesn't show up to eat. Yuki and Mii-kun search the club room floor while Kurumi checks the other levels. The shovel-wielding senior quickly picks up Taromaru's tracks, following them down to the first floor...beyond the barricade.

11.o: THEY flood into the school as if attempting to take shelter from the torrential rain. The power has been knocked offline. The School Living club room is under siege. Kurumi is unconscious after one of THEM bit her. All alone, Rii-san prepares to keep her promise. Meanwhile, Mii-kun prepares to go to the emergency shelter and find the vaccine, but the thought of having lost Taromaru to THEM drains her will to continue. Just as one of THEM reaches out to grab her, she's saved...by Yuki?!

12.o: The School Life Club is in grave peril, as swarms of THEM flood the school.

1.o: Miho wanted to attend a school that didn’t offer Tankery and she thought she did. But when the student council gives her an offer she can’t refuse, her past comes to haunt her.

2.o: With 5 tanks found, the Tankery class split into teams and stage their first mock battle.

3.o: Mako, who is revealed to be a childhood friend of Saori, joins the others on the tank, which soon comes across a perilous bridge which Hana has trouble navigating. After a hit from enemy fire knocks Hana unconscious, Mako takes over as driver and manages to safely navigate to the middle of the bridge. There, they manage to find perfect cover from enemy fire whilst Yukari takes out the enemy tanks, securing victory for Miho's team. Whilst celebrating their victory, the team decides that Miho should be the commander, with the roles of radio operator, gunner, driver and loader assigned to Saori,

4.t: I'll Do My Best As Commander!
4.o: Tank malfunctions, deserters, and trigger happy gunners. Miho will have her hands full if Oarai Academy is to survive their first match.

5.o: Miho's uneasiness about the tournament is worsened after a run in with her sister, Maho. Noticing Miho's worry, Yukari decides to infiltrate Saunders University High School to gather intel on their opponents for Miho to use as reference. As the others visit her house, Yukari's parents thank them for becoming her friends, as she didn't have any due to her tank obsession. The match against Saunders soon begins and the Rabbit team is soon put under pressure by Saunders' numbers. As Miho manages to get them to safety, she discovers that Saunders is using a radio interceptor balloon to eavesdrop on

6.t: The First Round Reaches Its Climax!
6.o: As Miho once again uses the radio interceptor to lure the rest of Saunders away, the Duck Team manage to find Alisa's tank and lures it into an ambush by the other Ooarai tanks. After learning the truth about the radio interception, Saunders' commander Kay sends an equal number of tanks to pursue Ooarai as they chase after Alisa, taking out both the Rabbit and Duck teams. Despite the grim situation, Miho calms her nerves and urges her teammates not to give up. Climbing up to the top of the ridge, the Anglerfish Team manage to take out Alisa's tank before they are taken out themselves, winning

7.o: Ooarai is doing well but the need to for additional tanks leads the group to searching the entire ship for new firepower.

8.o: Ooarai has gotten cocky with their recent victories and the upcoming match against Pravda will bring them back to earth.

9.o: The news of the school closure has hit the moral of the team hard. The offer of surrender is beginning to look more tempting as the hours creep on, but Nishizumi has other plans.

10.o: The final battle is coming up and students are approaching Nishizumi in hopes of joining Tankery. The Tankery club is on the lookout for new tanks.

11.o: Ōarai manages to escape Kuromorimine's ambush by using a smokescreen to conceal their retreat, where they take up defensive positions on top of a hill. A fierce battle begins, with Ōarai managing to disable several of Kuromorimine's tanks. Thanks to a distraction created by the Student Council, the Ōarai manages to retreat again while Kuromorimine stops to regroup. However, in order to reach their destination, Ōarai has to cross a deep river. Unfortunately, Rabbit Team's M3 Lee stalls in the river. Faced with leaving Rabbit Team behind or risk having Kuromorimine catch up to them, Miho is remi

12.o: Ōarai's team manages to defeat the Maus through a team effort, but Turtle Team's tank is damaged and disabled. The main Kuromorimine force descends on the town. In the fierce fighting, Ōarai's tanks are picked off, but Leopon's team blocks off a doorway, cutting off Miho and Maho's tanks from the rest of Black Forest's forces. A tank duel ensues between them, and Miho barely emerges victorious, winning the match in the process. The Ōarai crew and their fans celebrate their victory, ending with a parade through the town.

1.o: In an effort to end many years of tyrannical rule, five pilots and their Gundams are dispatched to Earth to begin Operation Meteor. Four land without incident, but one is intercepted and his mission is compromised.

2.o: Heero plans to destroy the Wing Gundam before it is discovered by the Alliance forces. Heero gets his hands on two torpedoes and attempts to destroy his Gundam. Relena, refusing to believe Heero's threat, tries to confront him but is interrupted by the arrival of Duo Maxwell...

3.o: Heero is injured and is kept for treatment at the Alliance hospital. At the Corsican base of the Mediterranean, the Gundam Heavyarms, piloted by L3's Trowa Barton, annihilates everything in its path. Then things get even worse for the Alliance when the Gundam Sandrock shows up.

4.o: L5's Wufei Chang, in his Shenlong Gundam, attacks the Taurus MS's transports after coming into Lake Victoria base late at night. Lucrezia Noin, head instructor at the base and good friend of Zechs Merquise, tries to fight him off in her Aries MS.

5.o: Relena and her father, Vice Foreign Minister Darlian, journey to the colonies to try and prevent war. but there are those who do not want peace. Amidst the grief and tragedy, Relena learns her true identity...

6.o: Relena goes back to Earth. Wufei attacks another Alliance base and Trowa has started to work in a circus as a cover. Back at school, Relena tells Heero that she knows everything about him and invites him to a party, to be held that night.

7.o: Treize Kushrenada's plans to destroy the Alliance come to a head when the leaders of the Alliance hold a meeting. The meeting is led by Marshal Noventa and outlines his peace agenda. However, based on Treize's false intelligence, the Gundams destroy the Alliance leadership, and Oz begins to take over Earth.

8.o: Lady Une makes the Gundams her next target and activates the self-destruct sequence on the New Edwards Base. Can Heero prevent the explosion of the New Edwards Base and find the person who set them up? Meanwhile, Wufei duels with Treize.

9.o: The United Earth Sphere Alliance collapses, sending the entire Planet into a panic. This allows OZ to step forward and take control through a well planned coup. Zechs is occupied with other things: he is searching for the ruins of the Sanc Kingdom.

10.o: Lady Une briefs her troops on another strategy to try and wipe out the Gundams. Heero and Zechs face each other again, but this time it's the Wing Gundam versus the Tallgeese.

11.o: The Gundams have been defeated. With the colonies used as shields, the pilots don't have a chance. No one knows whether Heero is dead or alive. On the trail of her father's killer, Relena heads to Moscow. Duo and Quatre take refuge with the Maguanac Corps.

12.o: The Gundams must fight to regain peace. Wufei meets Sally Po on the battlefield and tells her that the weak should not be fighting. Still, lost in his emotion, Wufei once again gets into his Shenlong Gundam.

13.o: Two misguided OZ soldiers are going on an execution spree, destroying any remaining Alliance resistance. In an effort to save the colonies, Trowa heads for his final battle. However, Catherine stands between him and his death wish...

14.o: To try and make up for his mistake of killing the honorable pacifist leader Noventa, Heero confronts his granddaughter, Sylvia Noventa. Meanwhile, Zechs is handed an order from the Romefeller Foundation...

15.o: Zechs' warrior nature craves a decisive battle. Noin invites Heero to Antarctica, where Zechs awaits. Suspecting that Zechs has violated the order to destroy Zero One, the Romefeller Foundation sends troops after him.

16.o: At the South Pole, Zechs waits with the newly-rebuilt Wing Gundam. After Herro arrives and the rematch begins, Relena arrives and tries to stop them from wasting their lives. However, she discovers a revelation...

17.o: OZ sets in motion its plans to destroy the Alliance military once and for all. Quatre and Duo head to outer space to warn the colonies of the impending danger, only to discover they've been declared the enemy.

18.o: The fight between the Tallgeese and the Gundams conclude. Now, Zechs refuses to fight for, and ends his affiliation with the Romefeller Foundation.

19.o: The Gundam Deathscythe single-handedly battles OZ's Mobile Suits in space, and Duo ends up getting captured. Heero searches for Duo in order to silence him...

20.o: OZ is developing 2 new Mobile Suits that can challenge the Gundams. Heero accepts the mission to sneak in and sabotage their operations. But he is unprepared for who he meets while inside the base...

21.o: A wild Mobile Suit approaches the colonies at high speed; Lady Une orders test pilots Heero and Trowa to stop it. Meanwhile, Quatre, exhausted from the pressure of his missions, returns home for a visit. But what he finds there is not comfort, only more chaos and tragedy.

22.o: The colonies have begun arming themselves for the coming fight against OZ. However, more surprising than that is the switch in Lady Une-she's become an advocate for peace. She is now acting on Treize's behalf without the consent of the Romefeller Foundation.

23.t: Duo, the Great Destroyer Once Again
23.o: With Lady Une's help, Duo escapes from OZ and goes to destroy the Mobile Suit production base on the moon. But while there, he meets a girl named Hilde who has become a soldier. The choice is suddenly much more complicated.

24.o: A Mobile Suit with fantastic power is on a rampage. It's attacking the colonies one after another in a brutal display of raw power. Trowa and Heero move to intercept this strange new Mobile Suit and are surprised by who its pilot is...

25.o: Trowa and Heero must battle their crazed friend; but they find themselves losing against this new Gundam. Treize, meanwhile, disapproves of the Romefeller Foundation's plan to use Mobile Dolls-automated Mobile Suits without pilots. His dissension results in his arrest by OZ.

26.t: The Eternal Flame of the Shooting Stars
26.o: Treize is freed by OZ soldiers loyal to him, but the trouble is only beginning. Romefeller is out to eliminate the Gundams and Treize, since they are symbols of hipe. Operation NOVA commences, and all of the Earth is in danger.

27.t: The Locus of Victory and Defeat
27.o: Relena, thinking back on past events, becomes determined to put an end to the Romefeller Foundation's tyranny.

28.o: Treize, while not in the middle of the battlefield, continues to scheme.

29.o: Romefeller is gaining ground on Earth very quickly and Treize and his troops seem to be losing the battle. When Heero realizes that Treize is now fighting Romefeller, he joins his army as a mercenary and finds himself working alongside Sally Po and Lucrezia Noin.

30.o: Quatre isn't convinced that Heero's mercenary path is the correct one. However, having witnessed the horrors of war, he cannot stand by and do nothing. When Relena declares the Sanc Kingdom's neutrality, Quatre and Heero take refuge.

31.o: Heero and Quatre decide to stay in the Sanc Kingdom and help Relena promote pacifism. But when the Romefeller Foundation attacks, Heero, Quatre and Noin go into battle.

32.o: Still in space, Duo has been retaliating against OZ. But OZ closes in, and Duo and his incomplete Gundam Deathscythe Hell must fight the Wing Zero.

33.o: Zechs steps onto the battlefield once again and attacks Romefeller's forces. Meanwhile, Heero heads off to help the Treize Faction.

34.o: Zechs gets the Wing Gundam Zero and demolishes the OZ forces. However, Treize gives Heero a new Gundam, perhaps the most terrible Gundam of all, and its name is Epyon...

35.o: Wanting to join the Gundam pilots in their fight, Zechs goes to meet Wufei, But Wufei, pilot of the new Altron Gundam, believes him to be the enemy.

36.o: Duo and Trowa are reunited and team up against the enemy once more. Meanwhile, the Romefeller Foundation has mounted a final assault against the Sanc Kingdom, forcing Relena to surrender to prevent a battle.

37.o: Relena, now a prisoner of the Romefeller Foundation, is faced with a very difficult choice. Meanwhile Heero and Zechs engage in battle once again-this time on the grounds of the Sanc Kingdom.

38.o: A group of rebel colony citizens calling themselves the "White Fang" starts attacking OZ bases. Quatre and Noin search for the other Gundam pilots. The Romefeller Foundation names Queen Relena as their representative.

39.o: Quinze, the leader of the White Fang, contacts Zechs and asks him-and his Gundam-to join their cause. Still suffering from amnesia, Trowa once agian goes into battle.

40.o: As Relena takes her first step towards trying to achieve true peace, Heero sets out to eliminate her. Milliardo Peacecraft, the new leader of the White Fang, is now intent on going to war against OZ, the Romefeller Foundation and the Gundam pilots.

41.o: With Milliardo Peacecraft's declaration of war against the Earth in effect, the battle rages on between the White Fang and OZ. Meanwhile, Treize returns to take control of the Romefeller Foundation, forcing Relena to step down. In space, the Gundam pilots encounter Milliardo and his Epyon.

42.o: The survivors of the destruction of Barge are brought to Earth, one of them being Lady Une. Treize reveals his true intentions. As the battle continues, Relena heads for Libra.

43.o: The Gundam pilots reunite. OZ takes control of a colony demanding the White Fang surrender Libra. When Trowa learns that Catherine is in the colony, he leaps to action. Meanwhile, Relena struggles to talk some sense into her brother.

44.o: Relena's plead for her brother to stop the war goes unheeded. The Gundam pilots battle their way though a fierce encounter with Mobile Dolls under Dorothy's control.

45.o: Milliardo leaves Quinze in command temporarily as he takes a rest. The Mercurius and Vayeate are once again used against the Gundams. However, this proves to be the two Mobile Suits' last battle.

46.o: Heero manages to get into the Libra and reunites with Relena to confront Milliardo. Treize challenges Milliardo with his new Tallgeese II Mobile Suit. To try and eliminate Treize, he fires the Libra...

47.o: The five Gundams launch their ultimate offensive knowing that only mass slaughter and a sad battlefield awaits them. The Peacemillion space fortress rams the Libra to block White Fang's way to Earth, even if it will bring their own death.

48.o: While Wufei fights Treize, Quatre fights Dorothy, Trowa tries to change his destiny, Duo frees the scientists, and Heero looks for Milliardo for the last round of their duel.

49.o: As Heero and Zechs come to the end of their final duel, the battleship Libra and Peacemillion descend upon the earth threatening to engulf the world in a never ending winter.... Meanwhile Trowa helps out the wounded Quatre, and Duo delivers the "lords of plague" to peacemillion, in the hopes of averting the tradgedy of the battleships plunge.

1.t: So Then a Bat or a Monkey
1.o: يحصل زواج "جول" و "شيلا" على بداية جديدة عندما تعتنق "شيلا" شخصية جديدة قاتلة بحق، وشهية قابلة لأي شيء... بعد أن كانا شخصين عاديين.

2.o: تحاول عائلة "هاموند" التأقلم مع واقعها الجديد، وتدرك "آبي" حقيقة مؤلمة وهي تتصفّح قصصًا مصورة، ويدعو "جويل" "شيلا" إلى وجبة مكلفة جدًا.

3.o: تعلن معدة "شيلا" عن جوعها ويتعين على "جول" إيجاد شخص طيب المذاق بسرعة، بينما تتصالح "آبي" مع شخصيتها الشريرة وتساعد صديقةً في وقت شدة.

4.o: تُلهم "شيلا" أصدقاءها وتُهين المدير، ويوطّد "جول" علاقته مع "آبي"، كما يصل "دان" إلى اكتشاف دامِغ وهو يقوم برشّ مبيدات النمل.

5.o: تكتشف "آبي" أن الآباء لا يمكن الوثوق بهم (وبالأخص أبويها)، ويعلم "جول" بإمكانية وجود علاج لـ "شيلا"، بينما يُفصح "دان" عن خواطره.

6.o: يقسّم "جول" و "شيلا" المهام فيما بينهما، ويكتشف "إريك" و "آبي" أمرًا ضخمًا بالصدفة، ويدرك "دان" أن سمسار العقارات له سقف من التحمّل.

7.o: بينما تبحث الشرطة عن "دان"، تأكل "شيلا" الدليل... لكن هناك الكثير منه. وفي هذه الأثناء، يتوقف "جول" لاشتمام القهوة.

8.o: يباغت "لوكي" كلًا من "جول" و "شيلا" بمظهره الجديد تمامًا، بينما يتعلّم "إريك" و "آبي" فنّ ترك الأشياء الحسنة وشأنها.

9.o: يبحث "جول" و "إريك" عن "أنطون" الغامض في مؤتمر الخوارق، بينما تتوطّد علاقة "شيلا" و "آبي" عبر حبهما المشترك للسلوك السيئ.

10.o: تستعد الدكتورة "وولف" للشروع في العمل، لكن مع سرعة تزايد عدوانية "شيلا" مع مرور الوقت، يساور "جول" القلق من أن يكون الأوان قد فات.

1.o: حسنًا، هذا هو الوضع: "جول" عالق في المصحة، و"شيلا" مقيدة بعمود، و"آبي" تسعى للحصول على مرارة شخص صربي. نعم، ما سبق ذكره صحيح.

2.o: حرصًا على تأمين قائمة جديدة مربحة، يطرح كل من "جول" و"شيلا" أفكارًا لإخراج سمسارين منافسين من قضية النزاع... دون اللجوء إلى القتل.

3.o: بعد أن طلب عدو قديم خدمة من "جول" و"شيلا"، يجدان نفسيهما متورطين مع النازيين، وتذاكر سحب لفريق البيسبول، وأعمال خشبية مذهلة.

4.o: يواجه "إريك" مشاكل مع فتاته، و"آبي" تشعر بالغضب، وهناك رأس متكلم في القبو... والآن اللازانيا على العشاء مع "ليزا" جارة العائلة.

5.o: يؤرق نقد ساخر على الإنترنت "جول"، بينما تتحول صداقة "شيلا" الجديدة إلى إشكالية، وتميل "آبي" إلى شخصيتها الجديدة.

6.o: هل للكولونيل علاقة بالمحار؟ لأجل ذلك يذهب "جول" إلى منطقة محظورة للبحث. أما "آبي" فلديها موعد غرامي، وتختلف "شيلا" في الرأي مع رئيسها.

7.o: يخطط "إريك" للتخفي كموزع للمأكولات البحرية، ولكنه يواجه عقبات. في غضون ذلك، يشعر "جول" و"شيلا" بالقلق حيال خروج "آبي" عن السيطرة.

8.o: يستجمع "جول" و"شيلا" أحداث الليلة الماضية بينما يتعاملان مع عائق مهني، وتجامل "ليزا" "آبي" وتمنحها مظهرًا جديدًا للغاية.

9.o: يدرك كل من "جول" و"شيلا" أن المحار الفاسد سيحقق كارثة أسرع مما كانا يعتقدان، وتتقبل "آن" النقد البنّاء بصورة مِهنيّة.

10.o: مع تضاؤل الخيارات وزيادة مخاوفهما، يخطو "جول" و"شيلا" نحو حلّ الأمور... ويتوصل "إريك" و"آبي" إلى خطة جيدة بتفجير مقطورة التصديع المائي.

1.o: تتساءل "شيلا" لماذا اختار لها الرب تلك الحياة، بينما يشعر "جويل" بالخطر، وتكشف "آن" عن سرّها، في حين يتظاهر "آبي" و"إريك" بأنّهما عاشقان.

2.o: تلتقي "شيلا" و"جويل" بأحد الفرسان وتبدأ "آن" في إرساء بعض القواعد، وتسري شائعة مفادها أنّ هناك علاقة حميمة بين "إريك" و"آبي".

3.t: We Let People Die Every Day
3.o: يريد "جويل" و"شيلا" أن تكفّ "آن" عن التدخل في شؤونهما، فليحالفهما الحظّ. ويبدي "إريك" ندمه على أفعاله، وتتوقّف حياة امرأة على سلطة البطاطا.

4.o: يقلق "جويل" لانضمامه إلى نادي الأموات الأحياء، فيما ترغب "رامونا" بـ"إريك"، والشرطة بأجوبة، و"السيد كرة ذو الأرجل" المسكين ببعض الاهتمام.

5.t: Belle and Sebastian Protect the Head
5.o: يخوض "جويل" و"شيلا" سباق ذكاء، أو شيئًا من هذا القبيل، ضدّ "تومي"، في حين يكشف "رون" عن مخططاته وتضطرّ "ليزا" المستاءة إلى التصرف بجدّية.

6.o: وفقًا لرأي "جويل"، يتعيّن على المرء الانضمام إلى "فرسان صربيا" كي يتغلّب عليهم. وأثناء ذلك، تتعرّف "شيلا" و"آبي" على الجانب الآخر من "جين".

7.o: تخطّط "شيلا" لتحويل "جين" إلى أحد الأموات الأحياء، فتظلّ بذلك على قيد الحياة وتقابل حفيدها. أمّا "جويل" فيعارضها، لكنها تنفّذ مرادها بالفعل.

8.o: يحدث تطوّر مفاجئ في تحقيق الشرطة يصعق "إريك" و"آبي"، وتعرض "شيلا" على "جين" نظامًا غذائيًا جديدًا، بينما يحاول "جويل" خداع "رون" المراوغ.

9.o: يتوق "جويل" إلى اجتياز المقابلة ليصبح أحد "فرسان صربيا"، لكنّ "شيلا" تواصل إفساد مخطّطاته، في حين تتجوّل "آبي" في المدينة برفقة صديق جديد.

10.o: يُولي شخص مرعب كامل اهتمامه بـ"جويل" و"شيلا"، في حين يثير زوّار جائعون دهشة "آبي" و"إريك"، ويفسد ثلاثي مُزعج حفل عائلة "هاموند".

1.o: After being rejected in over 30 job applications, Yoshino Koharu finally gets an offer. She probably should have read the contract more carefully...

2.t: The Gathering of the Five Champions
2.o: Yoshino faces her first trial as queen: sell one thousand boxes of the tourist board's mistakenly-ordered snacks before their expiration date is up!

3.o: Yoshino investigates the town's passion for kabura, which leads to a strange showdown between their two kabura-based mascots!

4.o: The Queen and her Ministers come up with some exciting ideas to promote Manoyama wood-carving! Unfortunately, not all of the locals are thrilled.

5.o: Yoshino recruits a local artist to help the team design a big project for Manoyama Sculpture. Meanwhile, Sanae reflects on her work and its meaning.

6.o: A film crew has arrived to film a zombie movie.  The Tourism Board attempts to cater to their demands while turning it into an opportunity to promote the town wherever possible.  Maki is having issues with her own aspirations as an actress.

7.o: The movie shoot and all the activity in town forces Maki to further reflect on her acting aspirations, as well as her relationship with her father.

8.o: Yoshino and the Ministers struggle to find the right dish for their new C-Rank Gourmet plan. Meanwhile, Shiori finds that her sister has a mysterious relationship with an old classmate.

9.o: Shiori reveals her plan to bring together the Board of Merchants and the Tourism Board, along with the rest of the town.

10.o: The singles in the local Community Club organize a matchmaking tour with women from the city, with Yoshino and the Ministers as tour guides.

11.o: The matchmaking tour continues! Meanwhile, Ririko investigates the tale of the town's dragon, and discovers some new things about herself in the process.

12.o: Yoshino and the Ministers prepare for the Kingdom of Chupakabura's Founding Festival, and are repeatedly surprised at who signs on to help out!

13.o: The day of the Founding Festival finally arrives. Will the help of the TV network pay off? How will it change Manoyama?

14.o: It's summer break! Yoshino reunites with old friends and family when she visits her hometown. Maki and Sanae go back to Tokyo, while Shiori and Ririko work on a B and B proposal.

15.o: A group of Spanish cryptid enthusiasts visit Manoyama in search of the Chupakabura. Meanwhile, Yoshino and the others work to find b and b's for Manoyama.

16.o: Ushimatsu's desperate attempts to pull something from the pond reveal a dark past.

17.o: The Ministers begin their search for the festival treasures, and introduce some of the more remote seniors to the Internet.

18.o: The seniors of Warabiya stage a revolt against the Kingdom of Chupakabura, and the Queen herself is taken hostage!

19.o: Maki receives a reply about her application for a role in a movie, and must once again reflect on her dreams. Meanwhile, Yoshino tries to figure out how the town can use one of their old, shut-down schools.

20.t: The Phoenix in the Holy Night
20.o: The Ministers open up an old school to serve hot lunch, and come up with a new plan to promote the old building when that doesn’t go so well.

21.t: The Pixie in the Town of Ice
21.o: Erika attempts to escape from Manoyama, but ends up staying with the Ministers. Meanwhile, Yoshino and Sanae try to gather support from shop owners for the Mizuchi Festival revival.

22.o: Erika continues her stay with the Ministers, and Shiori tries to convince her that Manoyama isn't such a bad place. Also, the hunt for the Golden Dragon comes to an exciting conclusion!

23.o: Yoshino receives an offer from an Manoyama alumni to open a branch of the highly successful Belem bakery in the town.  Many of the owners in the shopping district are unwilling to give up store space, as they still live above.  Meanwhile, Kadota informs everybody of some unfortunate news.

24.o: Dark rumors of civic plotting abound as the revival of the Mizuchi Festival draws near.

25.o: Will the festival be a success? Will Mr. Kadota make it back in time for the play? What will Yoshino do when her contract expires?

1.o: Yuuri and Chito make it out of the dark cavern on their Kettenkrad but what will they find on the outside?

2.o: Yuuri and Chito make their way through snow packed plains and begin to freeze. Will they be offered a reprieve from the cold?

3.o: Yuuri and Chito meet another person after he almost accidentally kills them. Will they help him with his request?

4.o: Chito and Yuuri are fixated on using their photograph machine, but they can't seem to get it to work. As they travel, they find a long forgotten temple.

5.t: House / Nap / The Sound of Rain
5.o: The girls continue to explore the ruins and they come across a house. Meanwhile, they take a nap which triggers some strange dreams.

6.o: An odd person with some ambitious goals enters into Chito and Yuuri's journey. She is willing to help them but only if they will help her in return.

7.o: Stuck in a labyrinth of pipes, the girls struggle to find their way out. Meanwhile, they look to make some food for themselves. What do they come up with?

8.o: The girls continue their journey as they venture into the unknown. With heartfelt conversations, they find out more than they bargained for.

9.o: The girls end up in a new facility where they meet a maintenance robot. With a fish and a lonely robot, they find the meaning of what it means for something to be alive.

10.o: Yuuri and Chito explore the ruins of an old town and are left puzzled with the little relics that are left behind.

11.o: As they continue their exploration, the girls run into some interesting creatures, and are left wandering an old weapons facility.

12.o: The girls discuss their realization of loneliness but still have dreams of getting to the next level with an aspiration of reaching the moon one day.

1.o: After being diagnosed with melanoma, Cathy decides to build a pool in her backyard, much to the chagrin of her older curmudgeonly neighbor, Marlene. Cathy's son, Adam, plays pranks on her while her husband Paul tries to get back in her good graces. Cathy also tries to reconnect with her willfully homeless brother Sean, and devises a weight-loss plan for Andrea, one of her summer school students.

2.o: Cathy learns from Dr. Todd just how little time she has left, and for the first time in her life, starts to appreciate her body. Paul tries to make sense of his wife's request to live apart for the summer by signing up for couples therapy. Adam, desperate to get away from his "crazy" mom, attempts to sneak off to soccer camp without her knowing.

3.o: When Cathy's attempt to connect to the people closest to her fails, she signs up for a well-meaning but overbearing cancer support group. 1.o: تلتقي الرسامة التجريدية "عطية" مع عالم الآثار "إرهان" الذي اكتشف رمزًا غامضًا بموقع حفريات "غوبيكلي تيبيه".

2.o: تعذّب رؤيا مرعبة "عطية" وسط تحضيرات زفافها، ويسترجع "إرهان" دليلًا يقوده للمرأة التي تستمرّ بالظهور في رؤيا "عطية".

3.o: تشكّ "عطية" بحدوث تعتيم متعمّد عندما تظهر هوية "زهرة" للعلن، ويسمع "إرهان" بنبأ ذهاب امرأة ضريرة لزيارة والده في "غوبيكلي تيبيه".

4.o: يهرع "سيردار" للعثور على "عطية"، ويرى "إرهان" رؤيا عن عائلته، وتبوح "زهرة" لـ"عطية" بسرّ مهمتها... وتكشف عن النسب الروحاني الذي يجمعهما.

5.o: تتقبّل "عطية" ماضيها وتواجه مخاوفها بينما هي عالقة بالكهف، ويهرع "إرهان" للعثور على مدخل النفق خوفًا على مصير "عطية" المعلّق بفتيل.

6.o: تؤكد صورة لـ"ملكة الأفاعي" شكوك "إرهان". وتكتشف "عطية" حقيقة صادمة أثناء التحقيق بمقتل عائلة "كورتيز".

7.o: يواجه "أوزان"، المنزعج من ضغط "سيردار" عليه، "جانسو" بشأن محاولاتها للاعتراف بالحقيقة لـ"عطية". وتهدّد خيانةٌ ما بتدمير مصير "عطية".

8.o: في استرجاع للماضي، تشارك "زهرة" "ناظم" بهواجسها بشأن "عطية" و"إرهان"، وتتّخذ "عطية" قرارًا مصيريًا سيغيّر الواقع لا محالة.

1.o: تُقحَم "عطية" في واقع جديد مضطرب، وجودها فيه كعدمه، إلى أن تقابل وجهًا مألوفًا في المكان الذي بدأ منه كلّ شيء... فمَن هو يا تُرى؟

2.o: يأمر "سيردار" "هانا" أن تراقب "عطية" عن كثب، والتي سرعان ما تكتشف علاقة "سيردار" بعمليّة تعدين يجريها "إرهان" وتلتقي رجلًا من ماضيه.

3.o: تعرض "عطية" دفتر "ناظم" على "إرهان" فيصادفهما رمز الخصوبة، ويتحرّى "مصطفى" عن ماضي "سراب"، ثم تدرك "عطية" أمرًا صادمًا، فما هو؟

4.o: بينما يصبح مصير "أوزان" على المحكّ، يسعى "سيردار" جاهدًا لتحديد مكان "عطية"، التي تعلم أنّها تحمل الأمل الوحيد لمستقبل البشرية... فكيف ذلك؟

5.o: تبدأ "ملك" ربط الأمور ببعضها، وتُكرِه "هانا" "ناظم" على مساعدتها في البحث عن "إرهان"، الذي تنتظره هو و"عطية" شخصية تحبّ الخير في "كبادوكيا".

6.o: ترسل "سراب" إشارة إلى "ملك"، في حين ترشد "سحر" "عطية" إلى نقوش الحجر التي ستساعد "إرهان" على تذكّرها، ولكن رحلة "عطية" تصطدم بعقبة.

7.o: في حين يوشك وقت "إيليف" على النفاد، يكشف "سيردار" عن سنواته الأولى المليئة بالمخاوف والمآسي ويُرغِم "عطية" على إرشاده إلى مدخل الكهف.

8.o: تنكشف الحقيقة الكامنة خلف وفاة النساء الحوامل، ويتقاطع الواقعان المتوازيان عندما تُكمل "عطية" مهمّتها... ولكن لكلّ أمر ثمنه.

1.o: تواصل "عطية" و"إرهان" البحث عن ابنتهما... وفي خضمّ ذلك، تُراودها رؤيا مقلقة تُزعزع كيانها، ويظهر رمزٌ روحانيّ من جديد.

2.o: يتتبّع "سيردار" مكان وجود "أدن"، لكنّ بحثه يأخذ منعطفًا سيّئًا. وتحاول "عطية" فهم إشارات تصلها من "أدن"، فيما يرتكب "أوزان" عملًا مُفجعًا.

3.o: يعثر "إرهان" و"عطية" صدفةً على جهاز غامض مرتبط بـ"المجتمع المجهول"، وتذهب "جانسو" إلى منزل "أوزان" وتواجه "ملك".

4.o: تساعد "أوموت" في ترجمة التسجيل المُستخرج من الصندوق الأسود وتنطلق إلى "ماردين" مع "إرهان" للبحث عن إجابات، وتكافح "عطية" للتواصل مع "أدن".

5.o: تسلّط راوية قصص الضوء على سلالة "أوموت" المميّزة وماضيها المأساوي. وفي "ماردين"، تقود شخصية مألوفة "عطية" و"أدن" إلى كهف تحت الأرض.

6.o: يطارد "إرهان" لصًّا مقنّعًا استولى على الخرائط من المتحف، وتوطّد "عطية" علاقتها بـ"أدن" وتعطيها عصارة شجرة الحياة في "دارا".

7.o: تعاني "أدن" من أصوات مختلطة تدور في رأسها، فيما تدرك "عطية" قدرات ابنتها التي من شأنها تغيير العالم، ويواجه "أوزان" "ملك" فتحدث عواقب وخيمة.

8.o: تكشف "ملك" عن دورها في مأساة عائلة "أوموت". وحين تتحقّق رؤيا "عطية" عن نهاية العالم، فهل تضطرّ إلى التضحية بأغلى ما لديها؟

1.o: Having conquered mountains and rivers in his homeland of New Zealand, his sights are now set on exploring the remote islands of the Pacific you can only get to by boat.

2.o: Ellis befriends a local named Lofi, and the two set sail for the isolated island of Tofua. Along the way they explore a newly formed volcanic island, navigate treacherous coral reefs, and must hunt for their dinner.

3.o: Explorer Ellis Emmett sets sail for the islands of Fiji, where he comes face to face with bull sharks, partakes in ancient Fijian fire walking rituals, and anchors in the remote Lau Islands, a beautiful place with a violent past.

4.o: Host Ellis Emmett has his first brush with royalty on the island kingdoms of Wallis and Futuna. 5.o: The Marshall Islands have a long human history, but it is the more recent saga that was thrust upon them during World War II and its aftermath that draws host Ellis Emmett to its shores. Following the Allied victory, the United States moved the local inhabitants from their quiet paradise in order to conduct atomic bomb testing at the famous Bikini Atoll. Ellis explores how, almost 65 years later, both the people and environment continue to be affected.

6.o: For thousands of years, the island peoples of the Pacific were masters of the ocean, braving angry seas in handmade canoes and navigating by the stars. But, these traditional ways are being lost to modernity. Adventurer Ellis Emmett helps get a traditional canoe back on the water, and sees first-hand how rising seas are changing life in the island chains of Kiribati.

1.o: The ragtag group of adventurers known as Vox Machina are commissioned by Sovereign Uriel to find out who (or what) is decimating villages in the outskirts of Emon.

2.o: Vox Machina tells Sovereign Uriel of the monstrous culprit behind the devastating village attacks, and manage to track the creature back to its hidden lair. For the safety of Emon, Vox Machina must rise to the occasion and go face-to-face with a beast that is seemingly impossible to kill.

3.o: Vox Machina is invited to the palace for a formal dinner, where Percy encounters murderous figures from his past: the mysterious Lord Sylas and Lady Delilah Briarwood. While gathering more information about the Briarwoods, a battle ensues. In the aftermath, the team discovers Percy’s tortured past has left something dark brewing inside of him.

4.o: After ruining Sovereign Uriel’s diplomatic dinner, Vox Machina is confined to their Keep under house arrest. While they stave off boredom, Keyleth convinces Percy to open up about his dark history and Pike fears she has lost her connection to her deity. Meanwhile, a looming new threat is on its way to confront Vox Machina.

5.o: Vox Machina journeys to Whitestone to confront the Briarwoods and help Percy reclaim his family home. As they travel, Scanlan studies Delilah Briarwood’s mysterious spell book to uncover clues. But the team’s first road trip is interrupted when the Briarwoods send horrific monsters to retrieve their missing book.

6.o: Vox Machina finds Whitestone's holy leader, Keeper Yennen, who tells them of a growing rebellion. The team realizes that to defeat the Briarwoods they will need the help of rebel leader, Archibald Desnay. But first they must stage a daring prison break and confront the Briarwoods’ sadistic jailer, Kerrion Stonefell.

7.o: As Vox Machina discovers more about a revenge pact Percy made years ago, Keyleth tries to magically connect with the Sun Tree. She senses its pain as well as a dark force deep below the city of Whitestone. Feeling underappreciated, Scanlan volunteers to infiltrate Duke Vedmire's mansion as a distraction while Vox Machina attempts to rescue Percy's sister Cassandra.

8.o: Vox Machina battles the vicious Professor Anders and his unique magical abilities, while Delilah Briarwood uses magic to summon a demonic army to rise against our heroes. Meanwhile, Pike searches for a way to reconnect with her deity, even if it means risking her life.

9.o: The Briarwoods' evil past connects with the present as Delilah reveals her pact with the Whispered One. In the bloody Whitestone streets, Vox Machina wages the fight of their lives against an undead horde. But just when all looks lost, the team gets help from an unexpected source.

10.o: After Percy confronts his old nemesis, Dr. Anna Ripley, a tenuous partnership is struck. Despite Percy’s protests that she can’t be trusted, Vox Machina brings Ripley along. She leads them through the traps under the castle, but soon the team is double-crossed by one of their own.

11.o: Vox Machina launches a final assault against the Briarwoods atop the Ziggurat. Battling the dark magic of Delilah and the vampiric strength of Sylas, a worried Vex and an unhinged Percy try to save their siblings. 12.o: Vox Machina has stopped the Briarwoods’ evil ritual, but at a heavy cost. As they flee the Ziggurat to save one of their own, Percy is eager to take revenge on their prisoner, Delilah Briarwood. When Vex implores him to let go of his vengeance, Percy must confront the darkness within himself.

1.o: Vox Machina's victorious return home to Emon is cut short by the arrival of ancient dragons, the Chroma Conclave. Despite Vox Machina's best efforts, the dragons lay waste to the city, forcing the team to find a way to escape.

2.o: Vox Machina travels to the mysterious ancient city of Vasselheim to search for allies. They're soon forced to turn to a group of seedy bounty-hunters, called the Slayer's Take. There they encounter an ancient creature who holds critical information that could help them in their fight against the dragons of the Chroma Conclave.

3.o: Vox Machina explores an ancient temple to search for their first Vestige of Divergence, a legendary weapon they hope will aid them against the dragons of the Chroma Conclave. As they overcome a series of dangerous encounters to reach the sunken tomb, one of the team makes a terrible mistake.

4.o: In a desperate bid to save a team member's life, Vax strikes a fateful deal with the Matron of Ravens, offering his life in exchange. As Vox Machina battles their way out of the sunken temple, Vax wonders what he's just signed up for.

5.o: While traveling to find the next Vestige of Divergence, Vox Machina passes by Pyrah, home to the Fire Ashari people. Discovering that the village is in distress, Vox Machina must help them, battling fire creatures that are spilling out into the world through a portal to another dimension. As they try to close the portal, Keyleth learns more about the power that lies within her.

6.o: Upon arriving at the location of the next Vestige of Divergence, Vox Machina must face the challenges of the mysterious sphinx, Kamaljiori – the mate of Osysa. But even if they can succeed, a new, unexpected threat lies waiting for them.

7.o: After escaping from the black dragon Umbrasyl, Vox Machina is split up. Half of the party find themselves lost in another dimension, the mysterious Fey Realm. 8.o: In the Fey Realm, Vox Machina unexpectedly discovers the city of Syngorn and meets Vax and Vex's father. 10.o: Despite his weakened state, Grog confronts his uncle, Kevdak, in a fight to the death. 11.o: While Scanlan makes a fateful and shocking discovery about his past, Vax confronts the Matron of Ravens to uncover the truth about the mysterious pact he made with her. At the same time, Vox Machina teams up with Grog’s Herd and sets their sights on Umbrasyl, preparing an ambush to take down the dreaded black dragon.

12.o: As the black dragon Umbrasyl escapes their attempted ambush, Vox Machina pursues him to Gatshadow Mountain. In the fearsome acid-filled tunnels of Umbrasyl’s lair, Vox Machina must make a final stand against the evil dragon.

7.o: In the ruins of Whitestone, Vox Machina makes a startling discovery - a clue from Ripley luring them to her remote island lair. Before they can resume the fight against the Chroma Conclave, they must deal with the serpent who's been nipping at their heels.

8.o: After a devastating loss, Vox Machina must take the fight to Thordak with one less memeber. They travel across Exandria recruiting allies to face down the Cinder King in his lair. Will the gathered might of the world be enough? Or will Thordak turn Tal'Dorei to ash?

9.o: Thordak strikes back! The combined armies of Whitestone and Syngorn are in trouble as the dragon's ambush is sprung. Betrayed by Raishan and left with nowhere to run, Vox Machina scrambles to find a new plan before their allies are wiped out.

10.t: To the Ends of the World
10.o: Thordak has fallen - though the price paid was steep. In the aftermath, Raishan absconds with Thordak's corpse. Vox Machina doesn't know her plan, but it can't be good. Fractured, they scatter on their own personal quests: vengeance, solace, and knowledge.

11.o: At sea, the twins fight for their lives against Ripley. Keyleth undergoes a dangerous earth ritual to locate Raishan, one that could cost her life. Pike and Grog's quest is no less perilous, as they struggle to convince Kaylie to help save Scanlan.

12.o: Merging her soul with a red dragon corpse, Raishan becomes an unkillable, undead monstrosity. She battles Vox Machina in her lair, trying to erase them before they can foil her plans.

Woo Ri contemplates her abstinence pledge and is on the verge of letting go of all her beliefs with Kang Jae. Meanwhile, Raphael returns from the hospital after beating cancer and tells Ma Ri he wants a divorce. To change his mind, she secretly plans to get artificial insemination done with the last of his sperm. However, Woo Ri is at the clinic at the same time and gets it done instead.

2.o: Woo Ri tells Kang Jae that she's pregnant with someone else's baby, shattering his marriage proposal. Meanwhile, Raphael and Mi Ja find out about the medical mishap. Although Raphael supports Woo Ri, Mi Ja won't accept it and tells the chairman about what happened. Chairman Kim desperately wants a grandchild and approaches Woo Ri with a box of apples.

3.t: Woo Ri Decides To Have Mallet, The Baby
3.o: Woo Ri makes up her mind and decides to have Raphael's baby. She tells him about it amidst a murder that happens in the hospital that pleasantly shocks him. However, Woo Ri starts to doubt Raphael after seeing him with other women and reading online articles about him being a playboy. She starts to follow him around to confirm her suspicions.

4.o: Raphael finally remembers he met Woo Ri before by the East Sea and starts to think their second encounter is a string of fate. Meanwhile, Woo Ri's oestrogen levels heighten with her pregnancy, causing her to lust for Kang Jae. However, the letter she wrote to him explaining her needs and desires lands in Raphael's email box. She runs to stop him from reading it, but it's too late.

5.o: Seoung Il tells Woo Ri that he is her father. Woo Ri gets shocked by the news and becomes angry at Eun Ran for lying to her. She packs her things and leaves the house. Meanwhile, Seoung Il finds out about Woo Ri's pregnancy and then causes a scene at the hospital that gets filmed and posted online, causing public outrage.

6.t: Kang Jae’s Lie Comes To Light
6.o: Kang Jae starts to feel left out, seeing Raphael next to Woo Ri all the time. Woo Ri senses this and tries to make it up to him by going on a camping trip with him. But later, she becomes devasted after she learns Kang Jae had lied about not knowing of Ma Ri's affair and how he had covered for her so that it wouldn't alter Woo Ri's mind about giving them the baby once it was born, putting their relationship in turmoil.

7.o: Woo Ri feels horrible for breaking up with Kang Jae and has trouble eating and sleeping, which doesn't go unnoticed. She even faints. Raphael tries to shower her with good food and rest, but Woo Ri won't accept it openly. Meanwhile, Kang Jae tries to get back together with Woo Ri as he tracks down a suspect that could link him to Chairman Kim.

8.o: Woo Ri moves on but starts having dreams about Raphael. Raphael also starts to have visions about Woo Ri. However, whenever he tries to tell her how he feels, something gets in the way. Meanwhile, Woo Ri becomes known as the virgin miracle, and Ma Ri uses that to her advantage and sticks a video DJ streamer on her to harass her.

9.t: Woo Ri And Raphael Start Dating
9.o: Woo Ri and Raphael tell each other that they have feelings for one another and kiss. Ma Ri, who just finalized the divorce with Raphael, overhears them and becomes frantic. Her mother tells her the only way to separate them is to get rid of the baby. Ma Ri listens to her and meets with Woo Ri. Meanwhile, Eun Ran and her mother go on a double date and find out something unexpected.

10.o: Someone breaks into Woo Ri's house to look for the necklace Ma Ri had secretly planted on her. As the culprit tries to get away, he injures Woo Ri's grandma, and she gets taken to the hospital unconscious. Meanwhile, Kang Jae receives a gift that leads him to Raphael's safe, and Du Pal gets away from Ma Ri and Mi Ja, causing them to go into hiding.

11.o: Kang Jae tries to stop Woo Ri from seeing Raphael, but Woo Ri doesn't believe Raphael has anything to do with Chairman Kim. After warning Raphael, he gets suspended from work for a week. Meanwhile, Raphael stays at Woo Ri's place for a few days and realizes Eun Ran doesn't think he is the right person for Woo Ri.

12.o: Kang Jae finds evidence in Chairman Kim's room, linking him to the murders. He arrests Chairman Kim, but things start not to add up as Chairman Kim gets abducted. As the chase goes on, Woo Ri gets stuck in the middle and gets taken as well. Kang Jae and Raphael rush to save her.

13.o: Kang Jae and Raphael apologize for what they did to Woo Ri and try to win her back. However, Woo Ri can't decide between Kang Jae and Raphael, driving her nuts. Meanwhile, Ma Ri tells Raphael her true intentions and identity, which leads to Kang Jae arresting Chairman Kim, the drug lord.

14.o: Woo Ri is just about to make her decision on who she is going to marry. But out of the blue, she ends up with appendicitis and gets rushed to the hospital. After Woo Ri recovers, she proposes to the one she knows will always be by her side. Meanwhile, Woo Ri's daughter, Ri Woo, comes into this world. And soon after, they celebrate her 100th day as a big happy family.

1.o: إنه أول يوم للصيف رسمياً، تذهب "بيلي" مع أخيها "ستيفن"، وأمها "لوريل" إلى شاطئ "كوزينس" لقضاء العطلة الصيفية مع "سوزانا فيشر"، التي تكون بمثابة أم ثانية لـ"بيلي"، وولديها "كونراد" و"جيريمايا". تذهب "بيلي" في كل صيف إلى شاطئ "كوزينس" منذ طفولتها، لكنها تشعر أن هذا الصيف سيكون مختلفاً. وتبين في الليلة الأولى أنها على حق.

2.o: إنه أول يوم لـ"بيلي" كمبتدئة، ويوم مليء بحفلات الشاي والتسوق يجعلها تشكك في قرارها بقبول دعوة "سوزانا". لكن عندما حضرت "كام"، تتحسن الأحوال بالنسبة لـ"بيلي". إنها البداية فحسب لصيف تجاربها الأولى. وفي غضون ذلك، يحظى "ستيفن" بصيف رومانسي، وتُفتن "لوريل" بكاتب وزميل لها.

3.o: إنه عيد الميلاد الـ١٦ لـ"بيلي"، تصل "تايلور" صديقة "بيلي" المفضلة للمشاركة بالاحتفال. عيد ميلاد "بيلي" هو يومها المفضل، لكنها صُدمت هذه السنة بسر كانت "تايلور" تخفيه عنها. آل "ديب" يسألون "بيلي" من سيأتي معها إلى حفل البلوغ. كما يُكشف سر "لوريل" و"سوزانا" أخيراً.

4.o: إنه الـ٤ من تموز، وقد أتى الآباء إلى "كوزينس" لحضور حفل "سوزانا" السنوي في منزل الشاطئ. يزداد التوتر بين "كونراد" وأبيه. يصنع "بيلي" والأخوين "فيشر" المارغاريتا، وتعم الفوضى. ولاحقاً تحظى "بيلي" بلحظة رومانسية ولكنها تتعرض للمقاطعة.

5.o: تتخذ "بيلي قراراً لأنها تعتقد أن "كونراد" سيعترف لها بمشاعره. لكن عندما تسنح الفرصة أخيراً للتحدث بين "بيلي" و"كونراد"، لم يجر الأمر كما كانت تتوقع، وتتساءل إن كانت قد اختارت الابن غير المناسب من آل "فيشر". يُكلف "ستيفن" بالعمل في صالة البوكر في النادي الريفي، وتقضي "لوريل" و"سوزانا" الليلة في الخارج.

6.o: تعود "تايلور" إلى البلدة للمشاركة في دوري كرة الطائرة الخيري في شاطئ "كوزينس"، ولمساعدة "بيلي" التي غلبتها الحيرة بالاختيار بين "كونراد" و"جيريمايا". بعد انتهاء الحفلة على اليخت برفقة آل "ديب" بكارثة، يتضح لـ"بيلي" من ستختار من بين الأخوين. ويجد "ستيف" نفسه عالقاً وسط أصدقاء "شايلا" الأغنياء، ويساند "كليفلاند" "كونراد" لتجاوز لحظة عاطفية مؤثرة.

7.o: إنه يوم حفلة البلوغ، لكن تكاد أن تُفسد ليلة "بيلي" المهمة عندما علم "جيريمايا" بالسر الذي كانت تخفيه عنه أمه طوال الصيف. عندما تُركت بيلي لوحدها في ساحة الرقص، أتى شخص آخر لإنقاذ الموقف. وبعد أن علم الجميع بسر "سوزانا" و"لوريل"، ينتهي الموسم بوعد تقطعه "سوزانا" وبالاعتراف الذي كانت تنتظره "بيلي" من "كونراد" طوال الصيف.

1.o: لم تعد "بيلي" الفتاة نفسها التي كانت نهاية الصيف الماضي. ففي آخر أيام الدراسة، وبعد عام صعب، تحاول "بيلي" الاسترخاء برفقة "ستيفن" و"تايلور" لكن بعض الأمور يصعب نسيانها.

2.o: تنضم "بيلي" إلى "جيرمايا" في بحث مهم، لكن عندما يهدد التوتر بفعل ماضيهما بعرقلتهما، يتعين عليهما إيجاد سبيل لرأب الصدع بينهما كي يساعدا "كونراد".

3.o: يُعرض المنزل الصيفي للبيع، لكن "بيلي" و"جيرمايا" و"كونراد" يأبون التخلي عنه بسهولة. وبينما يعمل "كونراد" على خطة سرّية، تحاول "بيلي" و"جيرمايا" اتباع طريق أكثر مباشرة. لكن العودة إلى "كازينز" برفقة الأخوين "فيشر" تعني عدم تمكّن "بيلي" من الهروب من ذكرياتها المؤلمة للعام الماضي.

4.o: كل شيء جائز في الحب وألعاب الممشى. إذ يثير يوم من التنافس مع الأصدقاء القدامى والجدد الكثير من المشاعر لدى "بيلي" و"كونراد" و"جيرمايا" ويؤدي إلى مفاجأة أكبر ستؤثّر فيهم جميعاً.

5.o: ليس عليكم العودة إلى المنزل، لكن لا يمكنكم البقاء هنا. تقتحم "بيلي" والمجموعة مكاناً مألوفاً لقضاء الليل بعد أن أرغمتهم الخالة "جوليا" على ترك المنزل الصيفي. لكن تغيّر المناظر سيجبر الجميع على التصالح مع مشاعرهم.

6.o: مع اقتراب نهاية إقامتهم في "كازينز"، تجد "بيلي" نفسها تتساءل عمّا كانت "سوزانا" لتفعله. والجواب أن تقيم حفلة ضخمة بالطبع. لكن هل ستقرّبهم الاحتفالات بالشكل اللازم أم ستتسبب في مشكلات جديدة للجميع؟

7.o: أحياناً يكون صداع الخمر هو الأسوأ، إذ تستيقظ "بيلي" على ما يذكّرها بالأخطاء التي ارتكبتها ليلة أمس. لكن هل فات أوان إصلاح كل شيء؟

8.o: بعد مصارحة مؤلمة، تعلق "بيلي" برفقة "جيرمايا" و"كونراد" في غرفة واحدة طيلة الليل. وتتصاعد المشاعر إذ يتعين على "بيلي" التصالح مع الماضي والحاضر لتقرر مستقبلها.

1.o: شارفت الجامعة على الانتهاء، و"بيلي" متحمسة لقضاء صيف رائع آخر في "كازينز" مع حبيبها "جيرمايا". لكن تفشل خططها بعد أن تكتشف حقيقة صادمة.

2.o: بعد خيانة صادمة، تسعى "بيلي" إلى لملمة شتات نفسها. وبينما "تايلور" في خضم المتاعب، تفتعل شجاراً مع "ستيفن" ينتهي بكارثة.

3.o: تخطط "بيلي" و"جيرمايا" لإخفاء خبرهما الجلل عن عائلتيهما حتى يجتمع الكل في "كازينز" لحضور مراسم تأبين "سوزانا" في الحديقة. الجميع عدا "كونراد".

4.o: تبلغ "بيلي" ٢١ عاماً، وهي بمفردها في "فيلادلفيا". لكن يستحيل يومها المميز إلى يوم بغيض حين تصبح الخلافات العائلية بشأن مستقبلها مركز الاهتمام.

5.o: بما أن "جيرمايا" يُضطر إلى العمل، يُجبر "كونراد" المتردد على مساعدة "بيلي" في ترتيبات الزفاف. وفي طريقه إلى "نيويورك" بحثاً عن فرصة عمل جديدة، يجد "ستيفن" نفسه مع رفيق سفر غير متوقع.

6.o: بعد انضمام "آدم"، أصبح حفل الزفاف يجمع أناساً أكثر مع مرور الأيام، وتتأثر "بيلي" بذلك بشدّة. ولكن بعد مفاجأة في حفل توديع عزوبيتها، بدأت الأمور تتحسن أخيراً.

7.o: ما يحدث في "كازينز" يجب ألّا يظهر إلى العلن. تنطلق "بيلي" و"جيرمايا" مع أصدقائهما في جولة أخيرة جامحة. لكن مع الإسراف في الخمر، تنكشف الأسرار.

8.o: حلّ يوم زفاف "بيلي" و"جيرمايا"، لكن اعتراف "كونراد" في وقت متأخر من الليل على الشاطئ قد يُفسد سعادتهما. مع تأجج المشاعر ونفاد الوقت، على "بيلي" اتخاذ قرار.

9.o: تتخذ "بيلي" قراراً بعد الزفاف يقودها إلى مغامرة جامحة ويغير مستقبلها إلى الأبد. في هذه الأثناء، يكافح "جيرمايا" لعقد الصلح مع "كونراد" وتقبّل ظروفه الجديدة.

10.o: يمرّ عام كامل ببطء شديد بينما تبني "بيلي" حياتها الجديدة في "باريس". في المنزل، يحاول "جيرمايا" أن يستعيد توازنه من دونها. وفي "كاليفورنيا"، لا يزال "كونراد" عاجزاً عن نسيان "بيلي".

11.o: كل الطرق تؤدي إلى "باريس" في هذه الحلقة الختامية الملحمية والمذهلة من المسلسل. يحلّ عيد الميلاد الـ٢٢ للفتاة المحبّة للصيف "بيلي"، فتنقلب الأحداث بشكل مفاجئ حين يحضر أحد أفراد العائلة الحفل، فيتعيّن عليها أن تواجه الحياة التي ظنت أنها تركتها وراءها.
